prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square country flag texture for the Europa Universalis IV Warhammer Fantasy mod, Swinetrade Empire, a Pigbarter-derived merchant and naval empire in the Dark Lands.
Primary request: a bold medieval heraldic flag, a large golden tusked boar in profile walking above a simple golden anchor, with a small imperial gold crown above its back. A fierce, practical merchant empire emblem, slightly rough medieval woodcut character.
Scene/backdrop: flat dark oxblood red flag field, one thin antique-gold border inset near the outer edge.
Style/medium: crisp flat heraldry, near-solid colors with very subtle aged paint texture. Golden boar with readable black inner cuts, tusks clear, stout silhouette; no tiny ornament. Anchor large and distinct below the animal.
Composition: square 1:1 full-bleed flat texture, edge-to-edge background, centered emblem filling 75 percent of the area, compact simplified shapes readable when reduced to a 128 by 128 pixel game flag.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, no shield outline, no flagpole, no perspective, no waving cloth, no scene or mockup, opaque background. This is the flag artwork itself.
